process.title: How Insight Pest Solutions Works
process.subtitle: A systematic, scientific methodology designed to eliminate active infestations and establish long-term structural barriers.
process.step1Desc: Our master technician inspects eaves, crawlspaces, weep holes, plumbing voids, and outdoor landscaping to map out pest nesting locations.
process.step2Desc: We apply botanical and micro-encapsulated treatments directly to harborage zones while sealing entry cracks with chew-proof materials.
process.step3Desc: A 30-foot multi-layered perimeter granular barrier is laid around your foundation to block future pest crawling paths before they reach doors.
process.step4Desc: We rotate active formulas each season to counter changing pest cycles. If covered pests return anytime in between, retreatments are free.

seo.title: About Insight Pest Solutions | Our Mission & IPM Methodology
seo.description: Learn about Insight Pest Solutions, our science-based Integrated Pest Management (IPM) protocols, and our commitment to safe, reliable pest control.

header.title: Smarter, Safer Pest Protection You Can Trust
header.subtitle: Insight Pest Solutions was founded on a simple principle: Pest management should be scientific, environmentally responsible, and family-friendly. We reject indiscriminate chemical blanket spraying in favor of rigorous structural exclusion and root-cause biological elimination.

coreValues.ipmDesc: We focus on habitat modification, physical sealing, and low-toxicity botanical active ingredients to eliminate colonies without impacting home air quality.
coreValues.certifiedDesc: Every field technician undergoes rigorous entomological training, background screening, and continuous state licensing education.

methodology.title: The 5 Pillars of Our IPM Methodology
methodology.subtitle: How we create long-term structural barriers that keep unwanted pests from entering your property.
methodology.pillar1Desc: Different pests require radically different treatments. Misidentifying an ant or cockroach species leads to ineffective treatments. We identify the exact species first.
methodology.pillar2Desc: We locate high-humidity micro-climates, plumbing leaks, and mulch contacts that serve as primary pest attractants.
methodology.pillar3Desc: We install chew-proof copper mesh in weep holes, exterior polyurethane sealants, and door weatherstripping to block physical entryways.
methodology.pillar4Desc: We apply non-repellent transfer formulas inside wall voids that foraging pests carry back to eliminate the queen and core nesting chambers.
methodology.pillar5Desc: We establish a continuous 3-foot foundation micro-barrier and 10-foot granular yard buffer that prevents new pest generations from approaching.
